title: Creator workspace, mobile review, desktop cockpit, and collaboration
objective: Keep the mobile review path simple and the desktop cockpit powerful without sacrificing accessibility, authority, or performance.

obligations.title: Every current journey is production-backed, responsive, keyboard-operable, and WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented
obligations.residualRisk: Strong demo visuals can conceal dead controls, mobile overflow, keyboard conflicts, or inaccessible review state.

obligations.title: Large projects, long transcripts, collaboration fan-out, and cockpit interaction stay within measured budgets
obligations.residualRisk: The cockpit can become unusable as assets, comments, transcript tokens, and collaborators grow.

obligations.title: Global collaboration obeys tenant policy, accessibility, retention, and complete attribution
obligations.residualRisk: Cross-region or external collaboration can violate policy even when the interface behaves correctly.
